section: Complete list of taxes: corporate, self-employed, contractor, non-resident and property taxes
label: Corporation Tax, with Domestic and Multinational Top-up Tax [national]
value: 25% main rate, 19% small profits rate, Marginal Relief between £50,000 and £250,000; 15% minimum effective rate for groups with revenue over €750 million. Paid by UK resident companies and UK permanent establishments of non-UK companies. Legal basis: Corporation Tax Acts 2009 and 2010; Finance (No.2) Act 2023 Parts 3 and 4. In force: financial year from 1 April 2026; top-up taxes for accounting periods beginning on or after 31 December 2023
